verdict.rationale: Jules can take tasks from GitHub issues via the "jules" label. The API docs say you can embed Jules into tools like Linear, but only by building your own workflow on the API, not through a native connector. There is no evidence of first-party integrations with Jira, ClickUp, or Monday.com, or of agents managing tickets directly (creating, updating, or closing them). Missing for 10: native connectors for Jira, Linear, ClickUp, and Monday.com; agent-side ticket management (create, update, transition); setup documentation; independent corroboration of any issue-tracker integration.
